concerns.text: Task T002 requires acquiring a verified open dataset with columns material_id, formula, band_gap, hardness, and crystal_system, but the current verified‑datasets block contains no such dataset. Without a source, the task cannot be completed nor can its verification (checksum validation and schema test) succeed.

Task T008 runs the full scientific study on the verified dataset and expects to produce results files and metrics. Since no verified dataset exists (see T002 issue), this task cannot be executed and its verification will always fail.

Task T013 writes the methods & results narrative and requires that every numeric claim matches a value in referenced JSON/CSV artifacts. With the scientific run (T008) blocked, there are no result artifacts to reference, making the task impossible to satisfy its verification script.

Task T014 re‑runs the entire documented workflow from scratch and records a handoff manifest. It depends on the successful completion of the full pipeline (including T008). Because the required dataset and downstream results are unavailable, this task cannot be performed nor can its verification succeed.

Task T004 adds an extra node feature ‘element_fraction’ to the composition‑only graph, deviating from FR‑002 which specifies only four features. This creates a mismatch between the task implementation and the approved specification, potentially causing downstream verification failures against the spec.

Task T006 specifies runtime guards that halt training if total runtime exceeds 6 h. Given the current CI environment limits (~7 GB RAM, 2 CPU) and the lack of a real dataset, the guard may trigger prematurely, preventing the task from completing its intended verification.

Task T010 is marked (gated) and depends on embeddings from a trained GNN on the full dataset. Since the full training (T008) cannot run, the required embeddings will not exist, making the interpretability analysis unexecutable.

Task T011 requires downloading CIF files via the Materials Project REST API, which is credential‑gated. Without an open, unauthenticated CIF source, the CIF fetch stub cannot retrieve any files, causing the task’s verification (including handling of missing CIFs) to be ineffective.
